subject: Enable protected-configs, debug and module commands in create-cluster script (#701)
reason: The change edits only utils/create-cluster/create-cluster, a developer helper shell script, adding --enable-protected-configs, --enable-debug-command and --enable-module-command to the valkey-server launch line for locally created test clusters. No server, valkey-cli, valkey-benchmark or check-tool code changes; the fuzzer launches servers itself and never invokes this script, so no runtime behaviour of the builds under test differs and no scenario can exercise the change.
